healingPerGame.definition: Total healing divided by match appearances.

ccPerGame.definition: Crowd-control time applied to opponents divided by match appearances.

damagePerGold.definition: Champion damage divided by gold earned.

killParticipation.definition: Kill involvements divided by the player's teams' total kills.

visionPerGame.definition: Vision score divided by match appearances.

turretDamagePerGame.definition: Turret damage divided by match appearances.

teamDragonKillsPerGame.definition: Team dragon kills divided by match appearances.

teamBaronKillsPerGame.definition: Team baron kills divided by match appearances.

teamHeraldKillsPerGame.definition: Team Rift Herald kills divided by match appearances.

teamVoidgrubKillsPerGame.definition: Team Void Grub kills divided by match appearances.

goldPerGame.definition: Gold earned divided by match appearances.

goldSpentPerGame.definition: Gold spent divided by match appearances.

goldShare.definition: Gold earned divided by the player's teams' total gold earned.

csPerMinute.definition: Lane and neutral minions killed divided by total minutes played.

neutralMinionsPerGame.definition: Neutral minions killed divided by match appearances.

teamJungleMinionsPerGame.definition: Tracked team-jungle minions divided by covered match appearances.

enemyJungleMinionsPerGame.definition: Tracked enemy-jungle minions divided by covered match appearances.

multikillRate.definition: Recorded double, triple, quadra, and penta kills divided by match appearances.
